## The `<head>` Tag

Which statement is correct about the `<head>` element in a valid HTML document?
options: There should be only one `<head>` element containing metadata like title, meta tags, links, and scripts
You should create one `<head>` tag for every section
`<head>` is optional and can be repeated many times inside `<body>`
`<head>` is used to display visible page content
correctAnswer: There should be only one `<head>` element containing metadata like title, meta tags, links, and scripts
